content.text: In regions where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-minimum-viable-stack-3|Payment Gateways]] platforms like PayPal and Stripe are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-what-actually-2|creators]] face significant barriers to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-11|COREMERCH guide to selling]] their products. This is particularly true in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where high fees from platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale, stifle profitability. The solution lies in leveraging blockchain technology, specifically Solana payments, which allow creators to sell digital products directly, significantly reducing transaction costs and enhancing sovereignty over their commerce.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-10. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Solana payment

Solana payments represent a breakthrough for digital creators looking to avoid costly platform fees associated with traditional payment processors. With NOWPayments charging only 0.5% per transaction, the financial implications are substantial. For example, if you sell a $97 product and make 100 sales per month, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments would amount to $921 retained. This difference allows creators to reinvest in their work or increase their margins, fundamentally transforming the economics of selling digital products.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture enabling Solana payments combines several free tools to create a robust digital commerce stack. At its core, you can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate payment processing and product delivery. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on the Solana blockchain, ensuring immediate confirmation without the need for a traditional bank or payment processor. This setup not only eliminates high fees but also provides creators with complete ownership of their data and products, ensuring a sovereign digital commerce experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors have failed them. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, the architecture allows you to maintain control over your sales and profits. It empowers artists, educators, and entrepreneurs to monetize their work effectively without the constraints of high fees or platform dependencies. By adopting this solution, creators can operate independently and pursue their passions without financial limitations imposed by conventional systems.
Keep 100% of your earnings by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of Solana payments hinges on several key components working in harmony. You will need a hosting solution, such as Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, to display your products. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script will handle the backend logic, while NOWPayments will facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Additionally, using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage and Google Drive for file delivery ensures that you can manage your digital products efficiently. Together, these components create a seamless experience for both creators and customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with Solana payments for your digital products, first, choose a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend using Google Apps Script to create automation for order processing. Integrate NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions, ensuring you configure it for Solana. Afterward, load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. Finally, ensure your files are hosted on Google Drive for instant delivery. This streamlined approach allows you to get your digital store operational without reliance on traditional payment systems.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments. It allows you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, significantly reducing fees. This method provides more control over your sales and eliminates dependency on restrictive platforms, enabling a more profitable and autonomous selling experience.
Instantly deliver digital products with automated systems.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're searching for ways to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all six blueprints and seven templates needed to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. You can find it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, unlocking your potential to sell cryptocurrency-only digital products efficiently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

To sell digital downloads without high fees, leverage NOWPayments with a sovereign stack. This setup allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments at only 0.5% fees, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad or PayPal, enhancing your profit margins.

To set up Solana payments, you'll need a hosting service like Cloudflare Pages, a backend solution such as Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for processing transactions. Additionally, use Supabase or Google Sheets for managing orders and Google Drive for file delivery.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using conventional platforms?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without conventional platforms by utilizing a sovereign commerce stack. By accepting cryptocurrency through NOWPayments, you avoid traditional fees and retain full control over your sales process.
Is it difficult to implement this payment system?

Implementing this payment system is straightforward. By following deployment guides and utilizing free tools, you can set up a fully functional digital store in a matter of hours, allowing you to start selling efficiently.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins. This flexibility allows you to cater to a broader audience while minimizing transaction costs.
Gain full ownership of your data and customer interactions.
